# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile portrait browser game called `Ghost Rule`: a Scream-inspired meta-horror mystery chase where a teen survivor is trapped in a self-aware slasher phone call. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: masked threats spawn in depth, advance toward the camera, can be tapped/clicked inside projected hit boxes to score one point, damage health when they reach close range, and are pushed back by holding a large bottom RUN-style control or device motion. Build the public surface as a single inline HTML/CSS/JS canvas game optimized for 4:7 to 9:16 portrait screens.

Presentation should be bold and authored: procedural Ghostface-like copycat silhouettes, VHS scanlines, ringing phone foreground, suspect-board strings, suburban night depth lanes, red-white-black palette, `NERVE` health, `ALIBIS` score, and `BREAK RULE` control copy. Use short mobile-readable instructions, self-aware genre jokes, and failure language around the cold open. Media must be optional, catalog-backed, and non-blocking.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
The source is a mobile-first canvas chase/shooter. Masked stalkers spawn at depth, walk toward the camera, and are removed when the player taps/clicks their projected hit box. Each removal increments score by one. A RUN button and device motion add retreat energy, pushing threats away while active. If a threat reaches close range, health drops by 20; zero health opens the game-over overlay. Start and restart reset score, health, enemies, and loop state.

## Protected Mechanics
- Tap/click projected enemy hit boxes to remove the closest valid target and score exactly one point.
- Repeating depth-based enemy spawn and advance loop using `requestAnimationFrame`.
- RUN button and motion-driven retreat energy.
- Health damage on close contact, zero-health failure, and restart reset.
- Mobile portrait actionability with canvas as the play surface and bottom RUN control.

## Transformable Surfaces
Title, HUD vocabulary, enemy drawing, background, foreground prop, panel copy, fonts, palette, particles, optional media feedback, and sound synthesis are safe to transform because they do not alter collision, scoring, damage, or input semantics.

## Remix Target
`Ghost Rule` reframes the same mechanics as a Scream-inspired meta-horror mystery: the player is a teen survivor answering a taunting phone call, tapping the white mask to expose copycats, breaking slasher rules to buy distance, and surviving until nerve fails.
